title: Over Strike 2 settings
description: The settings file every part of Over Strike 2 reads (docs/settings.md). JSON with comments; a string "env:NAME" or "file:PATH" is read from there.

schema.description: The file's format; this code reads schema 1.

name.description: The server's name in the sync's mails and on the dashboard (the image's CS2_SERVERNAME is the one players see).

host.description: How the bridge and the sync reach the game server: its container's name on their network.

port.description: The game server's port: A2S (UDP) and RCON (TCP). The image's CS2_PORT must say the same.

rconPassword.description: The RCON password: by default the image's own CS2_RCONPW, which it needs anyway, so the bridge's container gets that variable too.

startMap.description: The map a server start loads; the image's CS2_STARTMAP must say the same.

url.description: How the game server (the plugin, the restart watcher) and the sync reach the bridge.

port.description: The port the bridge listens on.

secret.description: The secret in the bridge's addresses (/log, /ready, /quitting, /removed, /reload ...): letters and digits. The image's CS2_LOG_HTTP_URL ends in /log/<it>.

officialMaps.description: The official maps the votes and the random picks may offer.

discoveryStock.description: The discovery stock: per mode, how many maps new to the server the bridge rolls ahead (the vote's surprise, the automatic picks), which the game server downloads in the background; 0 turns it off. The keep set's queues are this long.

changeDelaySeconds.description: The countdown before a map change.

restartCooldownSeconds.description: The least time between two !restart requests.

addon.description: Required: a server without the HUD cannot exist. The Workshop id of the HUD addon, digits only: the game server mounts it, and every client downloads it and keeps it across every map change. Missing, empty or not digits, the file cannot be used: the server programs refuse to run and the plugin does not load.

tab.description: The TAB chord: down puts the board down while TAB is held; off leaves TAB alone.

check.description: The HUD check: warn a player not seen clicking in the HUD of this release, and with enforce disconnect them; warn by default, so every player's HUD version is learned at their first click.

itemPage.description: Visit the HUD item's Workshop page to see whether Steam shows it to everybody (off on a test copy).

enabled.description: Install Metamod:Source, CounterStrikeSharp and the plugin before every start; false runs the server vanilla.

daily.description: The daily restart, local time, only while nobody is on; "off" for none. The sync keeps clear of it.

updates.description: Restart for a new CS2 build: at the end of the match, or at once with nobody on.

updateCheckMinutes.description: How often Valve is asked whether the build is current.

newVersions.description: Restart for a deployed new version of the server's own parts the same way: at the end of the match, or at once with nobody on.

freezeRecovery.description: Kill a frozen engine so Docker starts it again.

downloadRestart.description: Restart an engine process whose Workshop downloads are stuck, only while nobody is on.

layout.description: Keep the maps in folders per type, linked from Steam's folder; off leaves Steam's layout alone.

delete.description: At every engine start, delete the maps outside the keep set; dryrun lists them only.

backgroundDownloads.description: Download the maps of the bridge's discovery stock (queues.json) in the background, also while people play.

downloadLine.description: Say on the HUD's top line what the server downloads for a waiting player, with its progress.

enabled.description: Runs at all; a manual run (run-now) works either way.

publish.description: Write the results into the bridge's data; false runs every step and writes nothing.

runHours.description: The longest run; the next starts while nobody plays and work waits.

apiEveryHours.description: Discovery, the check and the ratings at most this often.

excludeIds.description: Workshop ids that are never candidates (the HUD item, hud.addon, never is).

excludeCreators.description: SteamID64s of Workshop authors whose maps are listed by hand (your own).

changedSince.description: A listed map updated after this day (YYYY-MM-DD) counts as changed at its first check; empty: none does.

modeBackfill.description: Listed Arms Race maps that carry a mode's tag join that mode's list too, untested in it.

apiRunCap.description: Web API calls in one run, at most (never above sync.apiDayCap).

apiDayCap.description: Web API calls in any 24 hours, at most; 10,000 is the hard limit (10% of Valve's daily allowance per key).

downloadPauseSeconds.description: The pause between two SteamCMD downloads; at least 2 s.

holdSeconds.description: How long the test engine must hold a map with two bots for a pass.

batch.description: Downloads per batch; a batch is downloaded, tested and published before the next.

quietMinutes.description: How long the server must have had nobody on before a run, after somebody was seen or the service started.

testPort.description: The test engine's port inside the sync's container.

engineStartsMax.description: Test engine starts in one run, at most; each is an anonymous game-server logon.

ratings.description: Fetch the Workshop's scores, subscriptions and trend once a day (the keep set's top lists).

handover.description: Hand the keep set's maps and their tested updates over to the game server.

diskLowGb.description: Less free space than this on the game's volume is a problem for the mail.

webApiKey.description: The Steam Web API key, for discovery and the ratings; without one those steps are skipped.

smtpHost.description: The SMTP relay for the problem mails; empty: no mail.

dashboardUrl.description: The dashboard's address every problem mail points to.

apiGapSeconds.description: Each program's Steam Web API calls go one at a time, at least this long after the last one ended; never under 2 s.

bridgeData.description: The bridge's data folder: read-write in the bridge and the sync, read-only in the game server - mounted at the same path in all three.

gameDir.description: The game server's install (the image's STEAMAPPDIR); the sync mounts it read-only at the same path.

handover.description: The hand-over folder as the game server sees it: inside paths.gameDir, so a take-in is one rename.

syncState.description: The sync's state, ledger, reports and backups (kept, backed up).

syncWork.description: The sync's staging, test engine tree and hand-overs (<it>/handover is paths.handover in the game server); on the game's volume.

syncCfg.description: Mode cfgs copied over the test engine's own; empty: none.

steamCmd.description: SteamCMD in the sync's container (the image's own).

depotcache.description: Where the Steam client keeps the manifests it verified; on a volume, so a new container re-checks nothing.

plugins.description: The CounterStrikeSharp plugins to install, one folder each (read-only): copied into the game before every engine start.
